div.div: Relational schema — page 6: the two SQL views. Views store no rows; they are recomputed from base tables on every query. The GUI and the read-only assistant read them.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 602px; height: 1px; padding-top: 75px; margin-left: 10px;

div.div:
VIEW v_lot_stock — one row per harvest lot
Columns: lot_id, cycle_id, farm_id, farm_name, emirate_name, crop_id, crop_name, unit_id, unit_code, quantity_harvested, harvest_date, sell_by_date, is_active, on_hand, reserved, available
Reads: harvest_lots ⋈ crop_cycles ⋈ farms ⋈ emirates ⋈ crops ⋈ units, LEFT JOIN stock_movements, GROUP BY lot
on_hand = Σ HARVEST_ADDED + Σ CORRECTION (signed) − Σ DELIVERED − Σ LOSS − Σ DONATED − Σ DISPOSED
reserved = Σ RESERVED − Σ RESERVATION_RELEASED − Σ DELIVERED
available = on_hand − reserved
Unit = the lot's unit (units are never mixed). A lot with no movements shows 0/0/0. Expected harvest (crop_cycles.expected_quantity) is not an input: forecast stays separate from stock.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(243, 229, 245), rgb(45, 33, 47)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(106, 27, 154), rgb(237, 169, 255));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 602px; height: 1px; padding-top: 75px; margin-left: 670px;

div.div:
VIEW v_request_status — one row per market request
Columns: request_id, market_id, market_name, emirate_name, crop_id, crop_name, requested_quantity, unit_code, needed_by_date, status, created_at, allocated_quantity, received_quantity
Reads: market_requests ⋈ markets ⋈ emirates ⋈ crops ⋈ units, with correlated sub-queries on allocations and delivery_receipts
allocated_quantity = Σ allocations.allocated_quantity WHERE status ≠ 'RELEASED' (includes already-delivered allocations)
received_quantity = Σ delivery_receipts.received_quantity over the request's allocations
status is the stored market_requests.status, maintained by app/db.py (_refresh_request_status); the view does not recompute it.
